summary: Decimal::from_scientific adds a negative exponent's magnitude to the mantissa scale without first bounding it. The upstream regression input "-20165.4676_e-+4294967292" adds 4294967292 to scale 4, overflowing u32 and panicking when overflow checks are enabled. The fix rejects magnitudes above MAX_SCALE before addition, returning ScaleExceedsMaximumPrecision. The reversal removes only this new guard and preserves the regression test extended by the fix. No tests were run.
